objective: Bootstrap a bounded Copilot coding runner on GitHub Actions that proposes genuine small Python corrections with deterministic tests and independent non-executing PR publication, without changing financial/trading state.
scope: Run governed fixed task FIN-P24-WZ-005 on an isolated temporary GitHub Actions checkout on a fixed schedule or owner dispatch.
Use pinned GitHub Copilot CLI with separately provisioned Copilot Requests token and only read/write file tools, no shell or GitHub write token.
Bound model edit/test retries to 2 and source/test paths to scripts/dev/doctor.py and tests/foundation/test_dev_doctor.py.
After passing tests, create SHA256 report and <=32KiB diff; privileged downstream job verifies scope, exact main SHA and evidence before draft PR.
Publish unit tests and CI artifacts, optionally stream Demo-only progress events to authenticated Mission Control telemetry.
Leave PR protected and unfinished until actual exact-head governance, independent reviews and Owner gate.
out_of_scope: Unlimited self-modifying agents, arbitrary jobs, spontaneous production permission changes, unattended merge to main.
Live/Auto trading, external account operations, API secret disclosure, equity transfer, margin/leverage manipulation.
Model control of protected GitHub Actions workflow, repository credentials or CI rules.
False claims that task code generation succeeds without a Copilot authorization token, that all Finance phases are complete, or that demo/provider blockers are resolved.
secrets: COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN (GitHub Actions Copilot Requests, separate from bot repository write token)
tests: Python 3.14 compile and unittest discover -s tests/automation -p 'test_*coder*.py'.
Validate scope enforcement, patch checksum/hash, unsupported mode rejection, no model token fail-closed.
Verify exact-head PR Governance Verify success and coding-runner contract job success.
Before canonical task closure, run a true successful model edit/test cycle, draft PR creation and exact-head post-publication CI with no review bypass.
security_tests: AI model job has contents:read and no GITHUB_TOKEN/other repo write privilege available in the model subprocess.
Publish job receives write privileges only after report and patch guard, never executes generated code.
Enforce path, file size, patch size, no binary, no deletion, no sensitive files or changes to CI/workflows.
No automatic merge, no financial orders, no branch protection changes.
At most two model retries, one open PR per task, six-hour schedule, no escalation on bad evidence.
rollback: Disable workflow via fresh scoped PR or revert WZ-005 automation files after independent review.
definition_of_ready: Canonical governance contracts and independent A5/A8/A10 remain intact.
Copilot CLI provider/version reviewed and limited to ephemeral Actions; no new production runtime packages.
Owner has not delegated credentials to public browser; model authorization supplied only via private Actions secret.
definition_of_done: Code, workflow, contract, tests and documentation on reviewable PR.
Exact-head repository Governance, downstream contract/test job success.
Actual Copilot inference credentials validated and narrow edit succeeded with test evidence.
Real draft PR from independent guarded publisher validated; post-merge evidence collected if Owner approves.
GitHub-Linear parity updated and no Live/Auto or G13 promotion.
